name: Margins
description:
Most data tools guess. Margins doesn't. Connect 1,000+ sources — Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, Meta, Google, banks, payroll, inventory — and run your business from a Claude conversation on accrual-grade accounting data. Ask anything: sales and profits, blended ROAS, true SKU margin, cash runway, anomalies. Build dashboards and schedule reports in plain English.
Every answer is reconciled to the penny — numbers you can defend in a board meeting

_published_faq.name: How do I add Margins to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Margins to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.finaloop.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Margins MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Margins provides these MCP tools: get_fdql_syntax, list_datasets, get_dataset_schema, list_my_companies, execute_query, get_distinct_values, get_sample_rows, open_transactions_requiring_input, and open_integration_connection.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Margins?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Margins in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Margins requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Margins is developed by Finaloop, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
